cause_quote: The Ultrafast implementation passed `modelProvider` directly and returned the baseline tier when `params.modelProvider !== "openai" && params.modelProvider !== CODEX_RESPONSES_OAUTH_PROVIDER`, a condition that also matches an omitted provider.
user_saw: With ChatGPT sign-in, Codex used Ultrafast on the first turn and dropped to Fast on follow-up turns.
summary: The fix uses the run's provider when the thread omits it so resumed and warm turns can check the account catalog for Ultrafast support.
reasoning: The parent of #158703 already omitted provider attribution from stored native-auth bindings, normalized it on resume, and reused the stored value on warm turns. #158703 introduced the Ultrafast check with a guard that rejected that omitted value, and #160352 later added explicit Ultrafast selection while retaining the same provider argument.
